# Imperator fired this for every character (is_alive = yes is_dynasty_head = yes) on its pulse; EU5 has no character pulse, so on the
# country's monthly_country_pulse every such character is saved as scope:pa_character and the on_action is fired for the country.
#P:A TODO Verify in game that scope:pa_character reaches the events and that the load is acceptable
pa_imp_monthly_head_of_family_pulse_wrapper = {
	effect = {
		every_character = {
			limit = { is_alive = yes is_dynasty_head = yes }
			save_scope_as = pa_character
			root = { trigger_event_silently = { on_action = pa_imp_monthly_head_of_family_pulse } }
		}
	}
}

# Imperator fired this for every character (is_alive = yes in_cabinet = yes) on its pulse; EU5 has no character pulse, so on the
# country's monthly_country_pulse every such character is saved as scope:pa_character and the on_action is fired for the country.
#P:A TODO Verify in game that scope:pa_character reaches the events and that the load is acceptable
pa_imp_monthly_job_pulse_wrapper = {
	effect = {
		every_character = {
			limit = { is_alive = yes in_cabinet = yes }
			save_scope_as = pa_character
			root = { trigger_event_silently = { on_action = pa_imp_monthly_job_pulse } }
		}
	}
}

# Imperator monthly ruler pulse: the ruler is passed as scope:pa_character
pa_imp_monthly_ruler_pulse_wrapper = {
	effect = {
		ruler ?= {
			save_scope_as = pa_character
			root = { trigger_event_silently = { on_action = pa_imp_monthly_ruler_pulse } }
		}
	}
}

# Imperator in_naval_battle: fired on the commander every tick of the battle; here on EU5 in_battle (root = the supreme
# commander), the commander saved as scope:pa_character and the on_action fired for the employer.
pa_imp_in_naval_battle_wrapper = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_admiral = yes }
			save_scope_as = pa_character
			employer ?= { trigger_event_silently = { on_action = pa_imp_in_naval_battle } }
		}
	}
}

# Imperator in_land_battle: fired on the commander every tick of the battle; here on EU5 in_battle (root = the supreme
# commander), the commander saved as scope:pa_character and the on_action fired for the employer.
pa_imp_in_land_battle_wrapper = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_admiral = no }
			save_scope_as = pa_character
			employer ?= { trigger_event_silently = { on_action = pa_imp_in_land_battle } }
		}
	}
}

# fired for the owner of the losing unit (scope:actor), as vanilla does
pa_imp_on_battle_lost_wrapper = {
	effect = {
		scope:actor.owner ?= { trigger_event_silently = { on_action = pa_imp_on_battle_lost } }
	}
}

# EU5 root is the character; fired for the new country with scope:pa_character
pa_imp_on_move_country_wrapper = {
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = pa_character scope:target ?= { trigger_event_silently = { on_action = pa_imp_on_move_country } }
	}
}

# fired for the owner of the losing unit (scope:actor), as vanilla does
pa_imp_on_great_battle_lost_country_wrapper = {
	effect = {
		scope:actor.owner ?= { trigger_event_silently = { on_action = pa_imp_on_great_battle_lost_country } }
	}
}

# Imperator decade_country_pulse: about once a decade, as a 10% chance on the yearly pulse
pa_imp_decade_country_pulse_chance = {
	random_on_action = {
		10 = pa_imp_decade_country_pulse
		90 = 0
	}
}

# Imperator 00_yearly_country.txt (yearly_country_pulse effect): while the global variable stormbringer is
# clear (storm.25 clears it again), one random country with 25+ cities that is not at war starts the storms.
pa_imp_storm_pulse = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = stormbringer } }
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					num_locations >= 25 #P:A TODO Approximate: Imperator num_of_cities >= 25 (only needs to pick a large country)
					at_war = no
				}
				trigger_event_silently = { id = storm.1 days = { 10 60 } } # seas
				trigger_event_silently = { id = storm.11 days = { 10 60 } } # deserts
				trigger_event_silently = { id = storm.21 } # snowstorms
				trigger_event_silently = { id = storm.25 days = 2 } # maintenance
			}
			set_global_variable = stormbringer
		}
	}
}

# Invictus invictus_yearly_events_effect: harvest.1 333 days and harvest.2 148 days after the Jan 1 yearly pulse
# (winter / summer). EU5 spreads its yearly pulse over the year, so the season is picked by month instead.
# Both events set a 90-day global variable, so only the first country's copy each season does anything.
pa_imp_harvest_pulse = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { current_month = 12 }
			trigger_event_silently = harvest.1
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { current_month = 6 }
			trigger_event_silently = harvest.2
		}
	}
}

# Invictus on_province_occupied: a tribal occupier of a large civilized city may make a noteworthy find (20%,
# 10-80 days later), and the city gets disturbed_circles for ten years. Root = the occupier, scope:target = the city.
pa_imp_tribal_looting = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				government_type = government_type:tribe # Imperator controller = { is_tribal = yes }
				scope:target ?= {
					NOT = { has_location_modifier = disturbed_circles }
					NOT = { location_rank = location_rank:rural_settlement } # Imperator city or metropolis
					#P:A TODO Approximate: Imperator total_population 30/40/50 (by date) read as EU5 population; metropolis -> location_rank:city
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { current_year >= 650 }
						OR = { population >= 50 location_rank = location_rank:city is_capital = yes }
					}
					trigger_else_if = {
						limit = { current_year >= 550 }
						OR = { population >= 40 location_rank = location_rank:city is_capital = yes }
					}
					trigger_else = {
						OR = { population >= 30 location_rank = location_rank:city is_capital = yes }
					}
					#P:A TODO No EU5 equivalent: Imperator also required civilization_value >= 20/30/40 (by date)
				}
			}
			random = {
				chance = 20
				modifier = {
					factor = 0
					scope:target = { has_variable = tribal_looting_cooldown }
				}
				trigger_event_silently = {
					id = tribal_fun_inv.1
					days = { 10 80 }
				}
				scope:target = {
					set_variable = {
						name = tribal_looting_cooldown
						days = 1
					}
				}
			}
			scope:target = {
				add_location_modifier = {
					modifier = disturbed_circles
					days = 3650
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Imperator on_move_country: a pretender backed through successor support (successor_support_ci, monarchy_events.102)
# takes the rebel throne. EU5 on_civil_war_start: root = the original country, scope:target = the rebel country;
# warfare.13 runs on the rebel country with scope:old_country = the original one and finds the pretender itself.
pa_imp_civil_war_start_pretender = {
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = old_country
		scope:target ?= {
			trigger_event_silently = warfare.13
		}
	}
}

# Invictus on_civil_war_won / Indomita on_civil_war_lost: when the winner's ruler is a pretender we backed
# (complete_pretender_support = the supporter, warfare.12.d) and the supporter is allied to the winner, the winner
# becomes scope:puppet_kingdom and the supporter gets warfare.14 if it outranks the winner, else warfare.15.
# EU5: root = the winner in both on_actions.
pa_imp_civil_war_pretender_support = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				ruler ?= {
					has_variable = complete_pretender_support
					var:complete_pretender_support ?= {
						is_allied_with = { target = root }
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = puppet_kingdom
			ruler.var:complete_pretender_support = {
				if = {
					limit = { country_rank_level > scope:puppet_kingdom.country_rank_level }
					trigger_event_silently = warfare.14
				}
				else = {
					trigger_event_silently = warfare.15
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Invictus on_game_initialized: Olympia (Imperator p:439) becomes the site of the games and the first Olympiad
# falls on 11 April 454 AUC; olympic.12 then repeats every four years.
pa_imp_olympics_start = {
	effect = {
		location:pontikokastro = { # Olympia
			add_location_modifier = {
				modifier = olympic_games_modifier
			}
			trigger_event_silently = {
				id = olympic.12
				days = 1287 # 11 Apr 454 AUC
			}
		}
	}
}

	}

		pa_imp_in_land_battle_wrapper

		pa_imp_harvest_pulse
	}
}

	}
}

	on_actions = {
		pa_imp_on_character_death
	}
}
